pages.title: Block Ship Battle
pages.creator: Xorgeneric
pages.description:
Block Ship Battle is a pirate-combat game built around broadside cannon fire. Your guns fire sideways, so turn the ship to bring an opponent into position and time your attack around the reload. Sink rival vessels and collect the treasure left floating in the water.

Gold must be taken to a harbor to bank it before another ship sinks you. Six ships and captains offer different abilities and ultimate moves, while leveling up unlocks visible upgrades. Five modes include weather hazards such as storms, fog, and lightning. Maneuvering for a shot and deciding when to secure your treasure are both central to survival.

pages.title: swingpit
pages.creator: swingpit
pages.description: Swingpit puts a gorilla on a rope above a deep pit. Tap, click or press Space to release and aim for the center of the next platform. React to changing conditions such as wind, gravity and shrinking landing areas while trying to stay in play.

pages.title: CuboMunch 2048
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: CuboMunch 2048 combines steering a snake-like chain with merging numbered cubes. Gather matching values to make larger cubes and strengthen the chain, keeping clear of stronger rivals. Use the boost control when you need extra speed through the arena.

pages.title: Flick Shot Soccer
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Flick Shot Soccer asks you to drag out the direction and power of a shot, then release to kick. Judge the angle that sends the ball into the net. Adjust each attempt to improve the accuracy of your finishes.

pages.title: Bubble Pop Fairyland
pages.creator: Anna Inc
pages.description: Bubble Pop Fairyland fills its boards with colored bubbles to clear. Aim the shooter and fire into groups of matching colors so at least three join together and burst. Use the available blasters while working toward an empty board and coin rewards.

pages.title: Duo Family Santa
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Duo Family Santa pits Steve and Alex against each other for control of a Lucky Block. Take the block from your opponent and hold it when the timer ends. Gather socks for money while fighting to keep possession until the final moment.

pages.title: Panda Lu Treehouse
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Panda Lu Treehouse lets you build a home for a panda and act as its caretaker. Develop the treehouse and work through the activities around Lu's living space. Choose how to arrange the home as you continue caring for its resident.

pages.title: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator
pages.creator: BeruGames
pages.description: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator sends you through a low-poly city with police in pursuit. Dodge traffic, break through roadblocks and collect powers such as slow motion or an EMP blast. Unlock getaway cars while trying to extend the chase.

pages.title: OhPeach-It
pages.creator: CrudeProd
pages.description: OhPeach-It combines fruit dashing with merging. Hold and launch fruits into matching partners to create higher-level fruit, then turn the collection into juice for points. Use the available power-ups and idle features to keep developing the fruit chain.

pages.title: Sorting Candy Factory
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Sorting Candy Factory asks you to separate mixed candies into flasks for packing. Click or tap to move the sweets into the appropriate groups. Plan the transfers around the space available as the arrangements become more complicated.

pages.title: Fashion Princess Dress Up
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fashion Princess Dress Up turns a fashion-show task into a character-steering challenge. Swipe between choices to collect clothing, hairstyles and makeup that suit the requested theme. Consider the judges' preferences while trying to finish with the stronger outfit score.

pages.title: Army Truck Driver Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Army Truck Driver Online puts you on military transport assignments. Drive between bases, collect passengers and carry weapons to their destinations within the time allowed. Steer around road hazards and use the brake to keep the loaded truck under control.

pages.title: Slidee
pages.creator: Fast Games
pages.description: Slidee asks you to slide through a level while painting its walls. Find a route that deals with spikes, portals and collapsing sections along the way. Plan the order of your moves so a change to the level does not block the remaining work.

pages.title: Ragdoll Parkour Simulator
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Ragdoll Parkour Simulator puts you in an urban obstacle course. Move with WASD, look around with the mouse and jump across gaps to continue the route. Use the respawn control when a missed landing ends the current attempt.

pages.title: Parkour World 2
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Parkour World 2 sends you through block-built obstacle courses with increasingly demanding routes. Run and jump between the platforms while judging the space around each landing. Complete the current level to move on to another arrangement of parkour challenges.

pages.title: Fit Cats
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Fit Cats asks you to launch cats into a box and combine two of the same size. Each merge creates a larger cat, while a cat falling outside ends the game. Catch mice to gain opportunities for removing a troublesome cat from the box.

pages.title: Cute Cat Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Cute Cat Jigsaw Puzzle offers fifteen levels of cat-themed picture assembly. Connect the scattered pieces to rebuild each feline scene. Look for matching fur patterns, outlines and background details as you work toward the completed image.

pages.title: Forest Match 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Forest Match 3 takes fruit matching through a forest map with individual level goals. Complete the requested objectives within a limited number of moves and use boosters when helpful. Continue past hidden coin chests and other surprises along the journey.

pages.title: Parking Line
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Parking Line asks you to draw a route that takes a car into its marked parking place. Examine the starting position and the space around the destination before laying out the line. Complete one parking setup to try the next arrangement.

pages.title: Valentine Day Couples Goal
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Valentine Day Couples Goal helps couples choose looks for their Valentine's celebration. Pick makeup and clothing for the girls, then coordinate garments and accessories for their partners. Finish both sides of each couple's makeover before their romantic outing.

pages.title: 2048 Defense
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: 2048 Defense gives you a castle to protect from approaching enemy waves. Buy towers, upgrade them or drag towers together to merge them. Choose attacks such as explosive red shots or freezing blue ones to build a stronger defensive line.

pages.title: Hurakan City Driver HD
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Hurakan City Driver HD puts a sports car in a city full of driving tasks. Complete mission quests, perform drifts and tackle speed challenges to earn money. Use the rewards to unlock customized cars and continue exploring the streets.

pages.title: Tanks 2D: Tank Wars
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Tanks 2D Tank Wars sends armored vehicles against enemy tanks and equipment. Fire at the opposing force, confront boss tanks and call on air support when available. Spend the earnings on stronger weapons and upgraded tanks for later battles.

pages.title: Sticky Ball Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Sticky Ball Rush asks you to drive a collecting machine along a course and gather balls. Keep clear of blocks that reduce the collection as you advance. Bring enough balls through the hazards to finish the level.

pages.title: Color Snake 3D Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Color Snake 3D Online puts a colored character on an obstacle course. Pass through barriers that share your current color and avoid contact with differently colored ones. Choose an animal skin and keep adjusting the route to extend the run.

pages.title: Pajama Party
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Pajama Party lets you choose an outfit for a weekend slumber party. Browse the sleepwear options and coordinate a comfortable-looking style for the event. Compare the available pieces before completing the character's party look.

pages.title: Police Car Simulator 2020
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Police Car Simulator 2020 gives you a selection of police vehicles to drive on wide roads and countryside routes. Steer, brake and use nitro while exploring the driving area. Switch the camera view to try another perspective on the car.

pages.title: Shadow Ninja Revenge
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Shadow Ninja Revenge sends a ninja through an obstacle-filled journey with enemies waiting along the route. Jump and dash past hazards, throw ninja stars and hide when needed. Keep ready for the next attack as you advance through the challenge.

pages.title: Unstable Squares
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Unstable Squares challenges you to move a white ball between targets at the top and bottom of the screen. Avoid the erratically moving squares in between while making repeated trips for points. A collision with a square ends the attempt.

pages.title: Into Space 2
pages.creator: Barbarian Games
pages.description: Into Space 2 turns a rocket's journey toward Mars into an upgrade challenge. Complete missions and achievements to unlock equipment that helps you reach greater heights. Steer around hazards, manage the engine and use boosters to extend the flight.

pages.title: Cupcake Shop
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Cupcake Shop asks you to assemble cupcakes that match customer requests. Select the correct ingredients to earn points and keep the orders moving. The pace and difficulty increase as you successfully prepare more of the requested treats.

pages.title: Super Hero League Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Hero League Online gives different heroes powers for clearing enemy-filled puzzle scenes. Drag opponents, fire arrows, bounce shurikens or place bombs according to the selected character. Plan the attack around nearby objects while keeping hostages out of danger.

pages.title: Galactic Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Galactic Traffic puts a car on futuristic roads crowded with other vehicles. Steer through gaps, collect cash and pick up power-ups along the track. Reach the finish while keeping the car clear of approaching traffic.

pages.title: Snack Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Snack Mahjong adds movable and destructible obstacles to a tile-linking puzzle. Connect identical pictures along a clear route to remove them. Clear neighboring tiles to destroy wooden boxes, and work around steel blocks that can move but cannot be broken.

pages.title: Math Magic Battle
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Math Magic Battle asks you to choose correct answers to arithmetic problems as quickly as possible. Work through addition, subtraction, multiplication and division while building a better result. Keep checking the numbers before committing to the next answer.

pages.title: Super Heads Carnival
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Super Heads Carnival collects short contests involving football, chicken catching and food service. Pick an activity and follow its particular objective. Play solo or use the local two-player option to challenge a friend in the selected minigame.

pages.title: Hallowmas 2020 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Hallowmas 2020 Slide gives you three seasonal pictures to rebuild by sliding their sections. Choose a three-by-three, four-by-four or five-by-five arrangement. Study the picture details and plan the moves needed to restore the selected image.

pages.title: Bottle Shooting Game
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Bottle Shooting Game makes a slingshot your tool for breaking colorful bottles. Aim at the target arrangement and knock the bottles down to the ground. Adjust your shots as each level presents another set of positions to clear.

pages.title: Drift Max Pro
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Drift Max Pro puts a car into driving missions built around controlling slides and reaching the finish. Steer through the course and keep the vehicle balanced while drifting. Work through the objectives as you improve your handling of the car.

pages.title: Ambulance Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Ambulance Trucks Memory hides pairs of ambulance pictures behind cards. Reveal two at a time, remember the unmatched locations and keep finding identical partners. Clear the full layout before the level's timer runs out.

pages.title: Uphill Mountain Passenger Train Simulator
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Uphill Mountain Passenger Train Simulator gives you a train to control along passenger routes. Drive toward the next station and complete the service objectives while avoiding a crash. Adjust the train's speed as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Ludo king ORIGINAL Star Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Ludo King ORIGINAL Star Game brings the familiar race-around-the-board game to the screen. Roll the die and move a token according to the available result. Choose which piece to advance as you work toward bringing your side home.

pages.title: Broccoli Salad
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Broccoli Salad turns preparing a salad into a step-by-step kitchen activity. Follow the displayed instructions and work with the ingredients and tools provided. Complete each preparation stage to put the finished dish together.

pages.title: Dinosaurs Life Jigsaw
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Dinosaurs Life Jigsaw offers six dinosaur pictures with three puzzle modes to choose from. Select a scene and drag the scattered parts into their correct positions. Match the creatures' outlines and surroundings to reconstruct the complete image.

pages.title: Fish Survival
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Fish Survival puts a small fish in an ocean filled with larger fish that can eat it. Move with the mouse and stay away from the surrounding creatures. Find safe water and keep reacting to their approach to survive longer.

pages.title: Hungry Number
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Hungry Number starts you with a blue ball marked four. Move around the field eating smaller-numbered balls while avoiding values larger than your own. Keep comparing the numbers before choosing the next target to approach.

pages.title: Crush the Zombies
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Crush the Zombies challenges you to stop an uprising by destroying approaching zombies. Use clicks or taps to deal with different enemy types and work through the difficulty levels. Bombs and additional lives provide help while you chase a higher score.

pages.title: Dual
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Dual puts two linked vessels under your control at once. Turn left or right to move the synchronized pair through the hazards. Watch both positions before making an adjustment, since survival depends on protecting the two vessels together.

pages.title: PopStar Girls Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: PopStar Girls Dress Up prepares a singer for an important show. Begin with a spa and facial-care routine, then choose makeup and clothing for the performance. Coordinate the available products and wardrobe pieces to create the finished pop-star look.

pages.title: Exotic Princess Tongue Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Exotic Princess Tongue Doctor is a fictional treatment game with tongue and dental-care activities. Follow the prompts and use the pictured tools to remove the game's bacteria and attend to the princess's teeth. Complete the stages to finish her clinic visit.

pages.title: FZ Steam Trucker
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: FZ Steam Trucker gives you a steampunk truck carrying cargo over a rough track. Control the vehicle carefully around bumps and slopes so the load stays aboard. Reach the garage at the end without spilling the shipment.

pages.title: Extreme Jet Ski Racing
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Extreme Jet Ski Racing puts you on a watercraft for racing challenges. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, brake when needed and activate nitro for extra speed. Keep the craft under control while working through the water course.

pages.title: Volkswagen ID Buggy Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Volkswagen ID Buggy Puzzle turns six vehicle pictures into jigsaws with four piece counts. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces and reconnect the car and scenery. Increase the difficulty when you want a more detailed assembly challenge.

pages.title: Hidden Walls
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Hidden Walls is a reflex challenge about guiding a moving piece past walls along a changing route. React to the next section and collect gold where the path allows. Keep clear of the barriers to continue increasing the score.

pages.title: EG Rolling 3D
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Rolling 3D sends a ball down steep routes with obstacles in the way. Steer left or right to stay balanced and line up a clear path. Keep checking the next section as the ball rolls farther into the course.

pages.title: Spades
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Spades gives you an AI partner for a four-player trick-taking card game. Bid on the tricks your side can win and plan your play around that target. Try features such as blind nil while balancing the team's progress against the opposing pair.

pages.title: Halloween Special Party Cake
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Halloween Special Party Cake combines costume choices with cake decoration. Help the characters choose outfits for their Halloween celebration, then design a seasonal cake. Coordinate the available clothing and cake details to complete both parts of the party preparation.

pages.title: Darts Pro Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Darts Pro Multiplayer lets you play darts against the computer, an online opponent or a friend on the same device. Set the throw's starting point, direction and strength with taps. Adjust each attempt to improve your accuracy on the board.

pages.title: Physics Drop
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Physics Drop asks you to draw a route that helps a ball reach its finish box. Use lines to guide the movement and account for gravity as the ball travels. Change the drawing when the first path leaves the target out of reach.

pages.title: Vincy Cooking Rainbow Birthday Cake
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Vincy Cooking Rainbow Birthday Cake helps Vincy prepare a colorful cake for her birthday. Follow the recipe activities and work through the ingredients and kitchen tools. Complete the cooking stages to put together the rainbow-themed dessert.

pages.title: BFF Princess Vote For Quarter Finals
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Princess Vote for Quarter Finals lets Anna, Barbie and Ladybug dress in support of their chosen football teams. Pick clothing that reflects each favorite side and complete the fan look. The game's theme follows the 2018 World Cup quarter-finals.

pages.title: Sea Underwater Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Sea Underwater Difference challenges you to find five changes between paired underwater pictures. Examine the animals and scenery, then select each detail that does not match. Complete the sets at your own pace, since the game has no time limit.

pages.title: Numbers Sliding Puzzle
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Numbers Sliding Puzzle asks you to put the numbers one through fifteen into order. Click tiles to slide them around the available space and plan a sequence that completes the grid. Try for a quicker completion or use the automatic solve option.

pages.title: One More Pass
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: One More Pass turns football into a passing challenge. Send the ball between teammates, move it beyond the opposing defenders and look for a route toward goal. Keep possession through the next pass before attempting the finish.

pages.title: Whack Them All
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Whack Them All challenges you to click balls before they turn angry. Some targets need several hits, while special balls can strike multiple targets and create combos. Keep checking the field so another ball does not change before you reach it.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Twins Birth follows a fictional hospital visit and care routine for newborn twins. Help the mother reach the hospital, then work through the babies' weighing, diaper-changing and resting activities. Follow the prompts to complete the family's visit.

pages.title: Sweet Girl Makeover
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Sweet Girl Makeover combines a beauty routine with makeup and dress-up choices. Work through the available products, then apply lipstick, mascara and blush. Choose clothing and accessories to finish the character's new appearance.
